m: perfect isolation, abstraction, detachment from all other connections, detachment of the soul from matter or further transmigrations, beatitude, MBh.; KapS.; Sāṃkhyak. &c.
kaivalya mf(ā)n. leading to eternal happiness or emancipation, MBh. xiii, 1101.
a: kaivalyaṃ [kevalasya bhāvaḥ ṣyañ] 1 Perfect isolation, soleness, exclusiveness. 2 Individuality. 3 Detachment of the soul from matter, identification with the supreme spirit. 4 Final emancipation or beatitude.
